name: FailedScalpExit
longCondition: el_eq(ctx.MarketPosition(), 1) && el_le((double)ctx.BarsSinceEntry(), 1) && el_le(ctx.MaxPositionProfit(), failureDollars) && el_lt(low[0], sigLow)
shortCondition: el_eq(ctx.MarketPosition(), -1) && el_le((double)ctx.BarsSinceEntry(), 1) && el_le(ctx.MaxPositionProfit(), failureDollars) && el_gt(high[0], sigHigh)
